messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert PD#12984 fired for svc-router-proxy latency spike (threshold: p95 > 200ms). Autoresolve window=60s.

sara: acking, oncall here. seeing the page.

dan: ack — checking dashboards.

sara: thanks. no high error rates in traces service. any canaries?

dan: canary-ping shows a 30s spike at 12:05 UTC across eu-west synthetic. looks like 3 consecutive failures, matched the alert window. no downstream 500s.

maria: looping in infra — could be transient autoscaler churn, or network flake. tagging @infra.

sara: incidentbot: please suppress PD for 5m while we triage? (/pd silence would be ideal)

incidentbot: /pd silence issued by sara for 5m. silence_id=S-4572. Will auto-clear on resolve.

dan: pulled logs from router-proxy: ```
2026-03-14T12:04:58Z router-proxy[pid=34] p95=310ms connections=1200
2026-03-14T12:05:15Z router-proxy[pid=34] p95=185ms connections=1185
```
Looks like a short tail; CPU briefly spiked on node ip-10-0-3-42.

maria: checked node metrics — brief OOM-kill on sidecar container at 12:04:59, restarted. Could account for the latency blip.

dan: no customer-facing errors, synthetic ttl spike only. marking impact=none for now. :white_check_mark:

sara: starting handoff: dan will follow infra remediation, I'll keep watch. @oncall rotation — no escalation unless PD re-fires.

ops-bot: note added to incident log: "Transient router-proxy p95 spike; sidecar OOM restart; no customer impact; PD#12984 silenced".

incidentbot: PD#12984 auto-resolved at 12:06:34 (duration 132s).

sara: closing thread — no further action required, but create post-incident ticket to tune sidecar memory request and to add smoothing to synthetic canary (avoid 3-fail flaps).

dan: filed ticket INFRA-572 memory bump + canary-smoothing. assigning to infra.

maria: will follow up with a small runbook snippet: if PD re-fires within 1h, escalate to SRE lead and increase silence to 10m if pattern continues.

sara: thanks all. :thumbsup:
